api:
<Slope data={countries} name={|c: &Country| c.name} before={|c: &Country| c.before} after={|c: &Country| c.after} before_label="2010" after_label="2020" />
PropTypeDefault
before, afterFn(&T) -> f64required
before_label, after_labeltext under the two columns"Before", "After"
color_by_changebool: rises in the good colour, falls in the bad colourtrue
show_valuesbooltrue
y_axisAxisConfigAxisConfig::new()

One line per item between two columns. With color_by_change={false} each item gets its own series colour.

examples.title: Change by country
examples.description: Rising lines in green, falling in red.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn countries_slope() {
    let data = use_signal(countries());
    rsx! { <Slope data={data} name={|c: &Country| c.name} before={|c: &Country| c.before} after={|c: &Country| c.after} before_label="2010" after_label="2020" class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Palette colours
examples.description: One colour per item, no value labels.
examples.code:

examples.title: Channels
examples.description: Revenue share by channel, last year and this year.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn few() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[("Web", 42.), ("Mobile", 31.), ("Partners", 18.)]));
    rsx! { <Slope data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} before={|s: &Step| s.value} after={|s: &Step| s.value * (0.6 + noise(s.value as u64) * 0.9)} before_label="Last year" after_label="This year" class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Ten regions
examples.code:
#[component]
fn regional() {
    let data = use_signal(regions());
    rsx! { <Slope data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} before={|s: &Step| s.value} after={|s: &Step| s.value * (0.7 + noise(s.value as u64 + 3) * 0.7)} before_label="2000" after_label="2020" class="h-96" /> }

examples.title: Month by month
examples.description: Twelve months compared across two years, in palette colours.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn monthly_pair() {
    let data = use_signal(monthly(20., 60., 9));
    rsx! { <Slope data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} before={|s: &Step| s.value} after={|s: &Step| s.value + 15. - noise(s.value as u64) * 30.} before_label="2024" after_label="2025" color_by_change={false} show_values={false} class="h-96" /> }
}
